question: Reconstruct F5 published source-value condition contrasts within their qualified units and original measured endpoints.
decision: Assess numerical concordance with the source figures and identify observed direction, donor heterogeneity and unresolved design limits before later biological synthesis.
strongest_rival: Nested measurements, normalization, culture selection, source-label ambiguity and unknown assignment can create apparent effects that are not independent population responses.
discriminator: Use only fixed panel/cell ranges and contrasts, preserve every condition and missing value, distinguish technical spread from biological-unit uncertainty, and verify against the original workbook.
exposure_record: All publication outcomes and source workbook values were viewed during source qualification before this freeze. This is an exposed source reconstruction, never independent replication or confirmation.
biological_unit: Reported patient slices or donor-combination cultures or mouse cultures/normalized metabolite samples, with nesting and identity limits specified per panel.
nesting_and_overlap: No inferred row/well/sample pairing. F1 slices nest in unidentified patients; F2 technical values nest in two donor combinations with shared endpoints; F4/F5 preparation identities are unknown. Source panels are reused published data.
population_and_selection: Every value in the frozen per-job cell-range specification from official JCI188734 Supporting Data Values; no outcome-based selection.
endpoint: 3K_proline: Fig. 3K | Proline [Relative abundance]; 3K_hydroxyproline: Fig. 3K | Hydroxyproline [Relative abundance]
methods: Fixed cell-range extraction from the hash-locked metadata view of the official workbook; observed counts, arithmetic mean, SD and range; target minus reference mean differences; raw-point/mean plots. No standard errors or population intervals; no tests or sample-pair reconstruction.
missingness_and_exclusions: Retain every listed value and real zero. 5d D2 alone is an allowed source blank; never impute it. Unexpected missing source cells or nonnumeric/nonfinite values stop the run. No de-normalization of source values.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests, significance filtering or equivalence decisions. Every prespecified contrast retained.
precision_basis: Technical spread and source group differences do not justify population precision; no confidence interval is calculated.
interpretation_limit: Outcome-exposed source arithmetic only. No independent replication, patient effect from unassigned slices, source-cell mediation, flux, repair function or scientific acceptance. Panel-specific limits stay attached to figures and results.
stop_rule: Stop after the fixed functional source summaries and plots. Preserve unfavorable directions, blanks and failures. RNA integrity and annotation require separate frozen contracts.
amendment_reason: Initial exposed functional source reconstruction following the reviewed metadata checkpoint.
